name: dogfood-edge-global-routing-app
description: Dogfood app v1.43-4 — a global edge routing observability harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa/edge v1.2 advanced global-routing semantics (receiveAnycast + matchGeo + selectByLatency + markUnhealthy + d1-read-replica readFromReplica + reportLag) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 12-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the edge global-routing + d1-read-replica state machines deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits a Cloudflare Anycast + Vercel Geo + Deno Deploy edge routing + read replica affinity API sequence through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven stack when KIWA_EDGE_ANYCAST_URL / KIWA_EDGE_GEO_URL / KIWA_EDGE_D1_REPLICA_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_EDGE_GLOBAL_ROUTING_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 lifecycle stages (anycast-routing / geo-matching / replica-affinity) x 3 edge platforms so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real routing APIs stays observable.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/edge build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
